title: Choose the visual world for FlakeLens
question: The roll assigned Forecast Desk. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Forecast Desk
options.lineage: Broadcast and print weather forecasts: meteograms, radar intensity scales, odds in plain words
options.thesis: Flakiness read like a forecast: evidence over time, odds in plain words, never certainty.
materials: meteogram strips on a shared time axis
radar intensity scale as status colour
options.viewport: Night-map navy shell. The ranked list leads; every row carries a 12-run meteogram strip. The open panel's run history is a full-width meteogram with mixed commits outlined like a weather front.
options.risk: Turns cute if it goes literal: no clouds, suns or rain icons, only the forecast's discipline.

raised.raise: Run strips sit on one hairline baseline grid with tabular numerals, like a data plate.
Wasted time is right-aligned tabular minutes with a running total that never overflows its column.
In the panel the meteogram owns the full width with empty ground around it; nothing competes.
Opening a test dims the other rows one step, so the row and its panel read as one.

options.label: Departures Board
options.lineage: Railway departure boards: scheduled services, on time, delayed, cancelled
options.thesis: Every test as a scheduled service that should run on time, every run.
materials: status words in a fixed column
options.viewport: Tests listed like departures: rank, test, status word in a fixed column, last 12 runs, wasted minutes as 'delay'.
options.risk: The status board is the most common 'health' metaphor; split-flap animation would turn it into kitsch.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: Triage as a chain of decisions: the next test to fix is signed like the next gate.
options.viewport: Dark shell; one yellow band names the next action (Fix 1: checkout › applies coupon code, 14 min) above the ranked list.
options.case: Fuses well and holds product clarity; weaker audience identification with an evidence-first SDET culture.
options.risk: Yellow wayfinding collides with amber Flaky; yellow must be reserved for the next-action band only.

options.label: Neutral Product Grade
options.thesis: One neutral scale, one accent, every claim beside its proof.
options.viewport: Near-black shell, ranked list with Why sentences paired to inline evidence; one blue accent used a handful of times.
options.case: Holds product clarity; low audience identification, close to the category standard.
options.risk: Hard to tell apart from every dark developer tool.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Results as a pure black and white data field.
options.viewport: A black field of run bars with dense numbers in the margin.
options.case: No colour breaks the status-colour commitment and strobing fights calm triage.
options.risk: Unreadable status without colour; strobe is hostile to a working screen.
options.kept: Hairline tabular precision in the run strips.

options.label: Factory Sleeve
options.thesis: Every test a catalog number, names hidden in colour code.
options.viewport: A pulse plot of runs owning a black field, a fac-number index.
options.case: Hiding names in colour code fails clarity and accessibility.
options.risk: Decoding labels costs every user time.
options.kept: One plot owns its field with empty ground around it.

options.label: Mixtape J-card
options.thesis: Runs as a tracklist timed to the minute.
options.viewport: Side A and side B tracklists of runs.
options.case: Handwriting and paper are a costume on a dense working table.
options.kept: Right-aligned running times that must fit the side.

options.label: Title Card Wall
options.thesis: Tests as tiles; the focused one grows.
options.viewport: Rows of test tiles scrolling sideways.
options.case: Tiles break the ranked table that triage depends on.
options.kept: The focused item stays bright while context dims a step.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark developer-tool dashboard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, KPI tiles, data table: the arrangement every dev tool ships.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
